text: North York Community Council will introduce bills.

General Bills North York Community Council passed By-laws 1286-2024 to 1293-2024, subject to Section 226.9 of the City of Toronto Act, 2006. Confirmatory Bill North York Community Council passed a Confirmatory Bill as By-law 1294-2024, subject to Section 226.9 of the City of Toronto Act, 2006.
